title: Wicked: For Good
synopsis: Glinda has the crown. Elphaba has the price on her head. You're a school friend from Shiz who knows both of them. You can save one. Maybe.

nodes.text: A poster on every wall: 'Bring her in, alive or otherwise.' Elphaba's face is on it. So is your old roommate's. Glinda's broadcast plays softly from a megaphone — kind voice, terrible message.

choices.text: Go to Glinda first
choices.consequence: Begin where you can still walk in.

choices.text: Go to Elphaba first

nodes.text: Glinda is, somehow, both glittering and tired. She lights up at you the way she always did. 'You're here,' she says. 'Don't tell me I shouldn't be doing this. Please don't.'

choices.text: Listen first before you advise
Tell her this is wrong

nodes.text: You find Elphaba by following a trail no map shows — a kindness her broom leaves for those who knew her. She is thinner. The broom hovers beside her, mildly protective.

choices.text: Ask if she still trusts Glinda
Tell her you came to help

nodes.text: A council of Animals — Goats, Bears, a wise old Cat — meets in a cave. They are organized in a way Oz has not seen in years. They want a public ally. Elphaba thinks that ally should be Glinda.

choices.text: Carry the message to Glinda
Press Elphaba to lead them publicly herself

nodes.text: You sneak into the Wizard's private quarters. He is older than the poster art, smaller, drinking. 'I'm not the villain,' he says. 'I'm just a man who scaled badly.' He may be telling the truth. He may be drunk.

choices.text: Press him on the Animal cages
Get him to confess on a phonograph

nodes.text: Glinda's chief adviser was your favorite teacher and is, you now see, the actual villain. She compliments your hair. She drops, casually, that she knows where your parents live.

choices.text: Refuse to be intimidated
choices.consequence: Stand even if your knees shake.

choices.text: Play dumb and gather information

nodes.text: Fiyero is alive — disguised, scarred, in the rebellion. He thought he'd never see you. He hugs you with both arms still working. He is, somehow, less of a prince now and more of a person.

choices.text: Ask after Elphaba's plan
Ask after Fiyero's heart

nodes.text: The Wizard's regime holds public 'trials' of Animals every Tuesday. You and Fiyero, in the crowd, watch a Goat be sentenced for the crime of speaking. The crowd is mostly silent. A few cry. None move.

choices.text: Move first to disrupt
Document and leak it broadly instead

nodes.text: Glinda, alone, lets the act drop in front of you. She knows what she's enabled. She does not know how to undo it without dismantling herself.

choices.text: Help her plan a public reversal
Help her plan a quiet abdication
choices.consequence: Sometimes the right exit is small.

nodes.text: Three nights: an Animals' march, a Glinda statement, a Wizard ambush. You and Fiyero and Elphaba and (terrifyingly) Glinda map it out on a stolen schoolroom blackboard. The chalk feels like Shiz.

choices.text: Run the plan as drafted
Insert a contingency for Glinda's safety
choices.consequence: Plan for the worst person you love.

nodes.text: Elphaba pulls out the Grimmerie. There is a spell for unwriting the most powerful enchantment in Oz — but the cost is paid in something the caster loves. She looks at you for a long moment.

choices.text: Refuse to let her pay
Ask the Grimmerie if you can pay instead

nodes.text: Animals fill the Yellow Brick Road with a quiet roar. Glinda steps forward, in pink, and reads a statement that detonates the regime's narrative in one paragraph. Madame Morrible's smile drops for the first time in your life.

choices.text: Stand visibly beside Glinda
Stay close to Elphaba and her broom

nodes.text: An assassin's water bucket — actually a clever propagandist's prop — is meant to look like Elphaba melted. The plan: faked death, real escape. Elphaba, exhausted, considers it.

choices.text: Run the bucket plan
choices.consequence: Let her die to her enemies and live to her friends.

choices.text: Convince her to stay and fight publicly

nodes.text: Morrible calls a hurricane. You realize she has always been the one driving the weather. The sky goes the wrong color. The plan begins to come apart in front of you.

choices.text: Use the Grimmerie to break her hold on the sky
Get Glinda to publicly fire her in the storm
choices.consequence: Snap her authority in real time.

nodes.text: The Wizard, watching from a balcony, sees the crowd and the plan and the storm and, almost gratefully, takes off the great hat. 'I'm done,' he says into the mic. 'I'm just a man.' Glinda looks at you. So does Elphaba. The plan, suddenly, has a new ending.

choices.text: Replace him with a council, not a queen
Crown Glinda formally, with limits

nodes.text: Elphaba steps onto the palace balcony for the first time in years. The crowd, knowing the truth now, does not throw water. They throw flowers. Glinda is beside her holding her hand like they're in school again.

choices.text: Let Elphaba speak first
choices.consequence: Honor the woman who carried the hate.

choices.text: Let Glinda speak first
choices.consequence: Honor the woman who carried the deception.

nodes.text: Elphaba and Fiyero marry under a tree in the woods, the Animals as witnesses, Glinda in pink she's clearly made herself. You catch the bouquet by accident. Everyone laughs.

choices.text: Stay for a long, quiet year
choices.consequence: Some weddings deserve a celebration that lasts.

choices.text: Go home to your village to teach

nodes.text: Glinda and Elphaba, you realize, never stopped being who they were at Shiz. The world bent them in opposite directions and yet — somehow — they still finish each other's harmonies. You smile from the wings.

choices.text: Take the post they offer you in the new council
choices.consequence: Put your shoulder to the work.

choices.text: Take the smaller post in a province they trust to you

nodes.text: A council forms — Animals and humans, witches and ordinary citizens. It is imperfect. It is real. Glinda holds the gavel. Elphaba flies between provinces, an emissary nobody calls a fugitive anymore.

choices.text: Help draft Oz's first constitution
Take a long, quiet sabbatical

nodes.text: Crews lay new brick over a road that once led to a fraud. Children skip beside the workers. You stand at a window and decide whether your next year is a desk in the capital or a long walk through provinces you've never seen.

choices.text: Take the desk and write the words
Take the walk and let others write

nodes.text: Years later you watch Elphaba and Glinda fly between provinces on the same broom, both laughing, both lecturing each other about leadership. Some friendships outlast the worst chapters of a country.

You teach in the village school. You tell the children a version of events that is mostly true and entirely useful. They draw Glinda in pink and Elphaba in green and both of them as friends. They learn that's allowed.

The constitution you helped draft outlives all of you. The Wicked Witch, in history class, becomes a hero. Madame Morrible becomes a villain. Glinda becomes a complicated figure — which is exactly what she always wanted.

You become a quiet, beloved governor of a small province. You set up an Animals' school and a council of elders that meets weekly for tea. Elphaba and Glinda visit every Yule. The province survives them both. You sleep well.
You take a year and walk Oz on foot. You meet people who only know the story as gossip. You realize history is in the hands of whoever writes the songs. You write a few. They survive. So do you.
